name: AMZScout Skill + MCP
description:
Requires an active AMZScout Skill + MCP paid plan. Get one here: https://learn.amzscout.net/amazon-product-api-for-ai-agents

AMZScout connects Claude to live Amazon marketplace data for product sourcing and FBA research. It provides product-level analytics (price, estimated sales/revenue, reviews, listing quality, seller/price history), niche-level market snapshots (demand, revenue concentration, brand spread), keyword/PPC data, and side-by-side comparisons across products or niches. Includes an all-in-one AI research agent that answers natural-language questions ("Is this ASIN worth selling?", "Analyze the yoga mat niche") by orchestrating the underlying data tools automatically.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AMZScout Skill + MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AMZScout Skill + MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://chatbot.amzscout.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AMZScout Skill + MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AMZScout Skill + MCP provides these MCP tools: amzscout-agent, amzscout_analyze_niche, amzscout_analyze_product, amzscout_analyze_product_set, amzscout_compare_niches, amzscout_compare_products, amzscout_find_by_brand, amzscout_get_keywords, amzscout_recommend_tool, amzscout_search_knowledge, amzscout_search_products, and amzscout_usage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AMZScout Skill + MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AMZScout Skill + MCP in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does AMZScout Skill + MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AMZScout Skill + MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AMZScout Skill + MCP is developed by AMZScout. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
